app.name: 3D WMS
app.tagline: Warehouse management with a live 3D view
home.body: Set up your warehouses and draw their floor plans under Warehouses, receive goods against purchase orders, and pick, pack and dispatch sales orders. Workers use the Phone app.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the email and password from your invite.
login.expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
login.passwordSet: Your password is set. Sign in to continue.
invite.title: Set your password
invite.subtitle: Choose a password with at least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
invite.noToken: This page needs the full invite link. Ask your admin to send it again.
account.title: My account
account.changed: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
account.sessionsBody: Lost a phone or used a shared computer? Sign out everywhere, including here.
users.title: Users
users.col.name: Name
users.disableConfirm: Disable {name}? They are signed out at once and cannot sign in until enabled again.
invite.dialog.title: Invite a user
invite.dialog.body: You get a link to send them by WhatsApp or SMS. It works once, for 72 hours.
invite.dialog.name: Full name
invite.link.title: Invite link for {name}
invite.link.body: Send this link to them now. It is shown only once and expires on {date}.
rename.title: Change name
rename.name: Full name
roles.dialog.title: Roles for {name}
roles.dialog.hint: Changes apply at once, even on devices where they are signed in.
roles.title: Roles
roles.body: What each built-in role can do. Give a person several roles if they do several jobs.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.body: Every change and sign-in in your company, newest first.
error.AUTH_FAILED: Email or password is not correct, or the account is locked for a while.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
error.CSRF_INVALID: The page was open too long. Reload and try again.
error.INVITE_INVALID: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask your admin for a new one.
error.EMAIL_IN_USE: This email already has an account.
error.ROLE_UNKNOWN: One of the roles no longer exists. Reload and try again.
error.LAST_ADMIN: Your company must keep at least one active Tenant admin.
error.CANNOT_DISABLE_SELF: You cannot disable your own account.
error.NOT_INVITED: This user has already set a password.
error.PASSWORD_INCORRECT: Your current password is not correct.
error.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: Choose a password different from the current one.
error.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
error.NETWORK: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
notFound.title: Page not found
warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.newHint: Sizes in metres. The floor starts as a rectangle; reshape it in the layout editor.
warehouses.col.name: Name
warehouses.archiveConfirm: Archive {code}? It disappears from all lists and frees a place in your plan. Its history is kept.
warehouses.codeRule: Capital letters, digits and dashes, up to 20
layout.conflict: Someone else saved this layout while you were editing.
layout.label: Label
layout.help: Drag the blue corners to shape the floor. Double-click a wall to add a corner, right-click a corner to remove it. Draw zones, then place racks inside them: drag to move (snaps to 0.1 m), R turns the selected rack, Delete removes it. Red racks overlap or stick out of their zone; amber ones face a too-narrow aisle. Scroll to zoom, drag the background to move.
layout.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes to this layout. Leave without saving?
error.PLAN_LIMIT: Your plan has no free warehouse. Archive one or upgrade the plan.
error.CODE_IN_USE: Another warehouse or rack type already uses this code.
error.LAYOUT_CHANGED: Someone else saved this layout. Reload to see their changes.
error.LAYOUT_INVALID: The layout has problems that must be fixed first.
error.NO_DRAFT: There are no changes to publish.
error.WAREHOUSE_NOT_FOUND: This warehouse does not exist or you do not have access to it.
layout.drawing.title: Drawing the floor outline
layout.drawing.help: Click to place each corner (snaps to 0.1 m), or type the next wall length and press Enter: it goes towards the pointer, at 0/45/90° steps. Double-click or Finish when done, Esc to cancel.
layout.drawing.CROSSING: The outline crosses itself. Cancel and draw it again, corner by corner around the building.
layout.corners.hint: Type measured positions for an exact outline, in any unit (e.g. 400ft, 12.5m). X runs right, Y runs down from the top-left.
layout.rack.needZone: Draw a zone first: racks stand inside zones.
layout.drawing.OUTSIDE: Every zone corner must be on or inside the floor.
layout.name: Name
layout.zone.hint: Drag the area to move it (its racks move too), drag the square handles to reshape it, or type exact numbers above. Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copies it. The code starts every bin code in it, e.g. {code}-R01-01-01.
layout.live.bad: {n} racks overlap or are outside their zone.
layout.live.narrow: {n} racks face an aisle narrower than the minimum.
layout.shapeTool.hint: Pick a shape and type its real size. It is drawn to scale; drag it into place afterwards.
layout.rackLevels: {levels} levels × {bins} bins per level (from the rack type)
layout.rack.hint: Drag to move. Drag the side handles to resize this rack only, or the round handle above it to turn it (snaps at 45°). R turns 90°, Shift+R 15°. Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copies.
rackTypes.title: Rack types
rackTypes.hint: The rack sizes you place in layouts. Each rack in a layout can still be resized on its own.
rackTypes.col.name: Name
rackTypes.empty: No rack types yet. Add the rack sizes you use, then place them in a layout.
rackTypes.archiveConfirm: Archive {code}? It can no longer be placed. Racks already in layouts must be changed to another type before the next publish.
rackTypes.formHint: Sizes in {unit}, or type any unit (e.g. 9ft, 2.7m). Weight in kg, or with a unit (2t, 4400lb).
rackTypes.weightRange: Weight between 0.001 kg and 100 t, e.g. 1000 or 2t
rackTypes.editNote: Changes apply to every rack of this type at the next publish (racks resized on their own keep their size).
layout.publish.title: Publish this layout?
layout.publish.confirm: Publishing builds the real racks, levels and bins from this draft. Bins that already exist keep their ID and hand edits; bins of removed racks are removed. You can keep editing and publish again later.
layout.publish.done: Published: {racks} racks, {bins} bins ({added} new, {removed} removed, {renamed} renamed).
bins.title: Bins and labels
bins.search: Find by bin code, e.g. Z1-R01
bins.labelsFor: Labels print the bins starting with {code}.
bins.labelsAll: Labels print every bin in this warehouse.
bins.noMatch: No bins start with that code.
bins.empty: No bins yet. Publish the layout to build them.
bins.editHint: Overrides what the rack type gives this bin. Kept when the layout is published again.
layout.block: Build a block from this rack
layout.blockResult: {n} racks in the block, including this one.
view3d.title: 3D view
view3d.nonePublished: No warehouse has a published layout yet. Publish one in its layout editor first.
view3d.notPublished: This warehouse has no published layout yet. Publish it in the layout editor to see it in 3D.
view3d.keys: Click a bin for details · drag to turn · right-drag or arrows to move · scroll or +/− to zoom · T top · R reset · / find · Esc close
view3d.bin.title: Bin
view3d.status.note: Fill comes from stock and product sizes (weight or volume, whichever is fuller).
view3d.expiry.note: Colour of the soonest expiry date in each bin.
view3d.perf.title: 3D performance test (fake data)
products.title: Products
products.hint: Everything you store. Stock is always counted in the base unit; cases and pallets convert to it.
products.col.name: Name
abc.hint: A = picked most (80% of picks in the last 90 days), B = next 15%, C = the rest. Worked out every Sunday.
products.empty: No products yet. Add the things you store.
products.archiveConfirm: Archive {sku}? It disappears from lists and scanning. Its SKU and barcodes stay reserved and its history is kept.
products.formHint: Weight and volume are for one base unit; putaway uses them to check bin capacity.
products.skuRule: Capital letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore (up to 40)
products.uomRule: Capital letters, up to 10 (e.g. EA, KG, CASE)
products.weightRule: Weight in kg, or with a unit (950g, 2t)
products.volumeRule: Litres (1.1) or a box in cm (30x20x15)
products.unitsHint: For example CASE = 12 base units. A unit can have its own barcode, so scanning a case counts 12.
error.BARCODE_REPEATED: The same barcode is entered twice in this product.
error.BIN_FULL: That bin has no room for this (weight or volume). Choose another bin.
error.LEVELS_TOO_LOW: Too many levels for this height: each level needs at least 250 mm.
error.NO_BINS: No published bins match. Publish the layout first.
error.NOT_PUBLISHED: This warehouse has no published layout yet.
error.PRODUCT_CHANGED: Someone else changed this product while you were editing. Close and open it again.
error.PRODUCT_CONFLICT: Another product already uses this SKU or barcode (archived products keep theirs).
error.SORT_NOT_ALLOWED: This list cannot be sorted that way.
error.TOO_MANY_LABELS: Print at most 10,000 labels at once. Narrow the search first.
error.UOM_REPEATED: A unit is listed twice, or a larger unit has the same name as the base unit.
error.USER_UNKNOWN: One or more of those users do not exist.
products.imageHint: JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB. It is resized and cleaned (no location data) before saving.
error.FILE_TOO_LARGE: Files can be at most 5 MB.
error.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only JPEG and PNG pictures are allowed.
error.FILE_TYPE_MISMATCH: The file name and its content do not match. Save it again as a normal JPEG or PNG.
error.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: Pictures can be at most 16,000 pixels on a side.
error.IMAGE_UNREADABLE: This picture cannot be read. Try another file.
error.TOO_MANY_UPLOADS: Too many uploads. Wait a minute and try again.
error.TOO_MANY_EXPORTS: Too many downloads. Wait a minute and try again.
suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.hint: Who you buy from. Purchase orders and receiving use this list.
suppliers.col.name: Name
suppliers.archiveConfirm: Archive {code}? It disappears from lists; its code stays reserved and its history is kept.
suppliers.codeRule: Capital letters, digits and dashes (up to 20)
import.hint.products: Rows with a new SKU are added; existing SKUs are updated.
import.hint.suppliers: Rows with a new code are added; existing codes are updated.
import.rules: CSV UTF-8 (in Excel: Save As → CSV UTF-8), up to 5,000 rows and 10 MB. If any row has a problem, nothing is saved and the rows to fix are listed.
import.failed: Nothing was saved. Fix these {n} problems and import again.
error.CSV_NOT_TEXT: The file is not UTF-8 text. In Excel, use Save As → CSV UTF-8.
error.CSV_TOO_MANY_ROWS: Import at most 5,000 rows at once.
error.CSV_NO_ROWS: The file has a header but no rows.
error.CSV_BAD_QUOTES: A quoted value is not closed. Check the file in a spreadsheet.
error.CSV_BAD_HEADER: The columns do not match the template. Download the template and use its header row.
error.PARTNER_CHANGED: Someone else changed this record while you were editing. Close and open it again.
po.title: Purchase orders
po.hint: What you have ordered from suppliers. Approve an order so it can be received.
po.addProduct: Add a product: type SKU, barcode or name
po.cancelHint: The order stays in the list as cancelled. This cannot be undone.
error.SUPPLIER_NOT_FOUND: That supplier no longer exists or was archived.
error.UOM_NOT_FOUND: A product on the order no longer has that unit. Remove the line and add it again.
error.DUPLICATE_LINE: The same product and unit are on the order twice. Combine them into one line.
error.PO_TOO_LARGE: The order total is too large.
error.PO_NOT_DRAFT: This order is no longer a draft. Reload it to see its status.
error.PO_CHANGED: Someone else changed this order while you were working on it. Reload it.
error.PO_CANNOT_CANCEL: Only a draft or approved order with nothing received, and no receipt open, can be cancelled.
error.BAD_DATE: Pick an expected date within the next two years.
receive.title: Receive goods
receive.hint: Pick the order the delivery belongs to, or scan or type its number and press Enter.
receive.empty: No approved orders are waiting for goods.
receive.closedNote: This receipt is closed and its quantities are on the order.
receive.qtyHint: Count in the unit you scanned: a case barcode counts cases.
receive.damagedRule: More than 0 and not more than the quantity
receive.closeShort: Some products are still expected. The order stays open as partly received for the next delivery. The goods go to the receiving area, ready to put away.
receive.closeFull: Everything ordered has arrived. The order becomes received and the goods go to the receiving area, ready to put away.
receive.closeNote: Note (optional), e.g. driver, vehicle, delivery note number
error.PO_NOT_RECEIVABLE: Only an approved order can be received.
error.NOT_ON_ORDER: That product is not on this order.
error.CODE_NOT_FOUND: No product has this barcode or SKU.
error.DAMAGED_TOO_MANY: Damaged cannot be more than the quantity.
error.OVER_RECEIPT: That is more than is still expected on this order. Check the count.
error.RECEIPT_EMPTY: Scan at least one product before closing.
error.RECEIPT_CHANGED: Someone else changed this receipt. Reload it.
error.BATCH_REQUIRED: This product needs a batch number. Type the batch printed on the pack.
error.EXPIRY_REQUIRED: This product needs an expiry date. Type the date printed on the pack.
error.NOT_ENOUGH_STOCK: There is not that much stock in that place.
error.BIN_BLOCKED: That bin is blocked. Choose another bin.
error.BIN_OTHER_WAREHOUSE: That bin is in another warehouse.
error.SAME_PLACE: Choose a different bin to move to.
error.BINS_HOLD_STOCK: This publish would remove bins that still hold stock. Move the stock out first.
putaway.title: Put away
putaway.hint: Goods received and waiting in the receiving area. Pick one, take it to the suggested bin and scan the bin label.
putaway.empty: Nothing is waiting to be put away.
putaway.noRoom: No bin has room for this quantity. Put away fewer, or free a bin.
putaway.offList: This is not a suggested bin. It is fine if it has room; the system checks.
error.ALREADY_DONE: This was just done. Reload to see it.
stock.productHint: Scan or type SKU, barcode or name
move.title: Move stock
move.hint: Scan the bin you take from, the product, and the bin you put it in.
adjust.title: Adjustments
adjust.hint: Stock found, lost, damaged or expired, always with a reason. Above the company limit (LKR 10,000) a manager approves first.
adjust.formHint: Small adjustments apply at once; bigger ones, or products without a cost, wait for a manager.
adjust.binHint: Leave empty for the receiving area
adjust.waiting: Saved. It waits for a manager to approve it before stock changes.
adjust.rejectNote: Why (shown to the person who asked)
error.LOT_REQUIRED: There are several batches or expiry dates there. Tick "Batch or expiry date" and say which.
error.TO_BIN_REQUIRED: Scan the bin to put the goods in.
error.ADJUSTMENT_DECIDED: This adjustment was already approved or rejected.
stock.title: Stock
stock.hint: What is in the warehouse: by product, by bin, and every movement.
worker.title: WMS Worker
worker.install: Install this app on the phone
scan.title: Scan a barcode or bin label
scan.hint: Hold the code inside the frame.
scan.blocked: The camera is blocked. Allow it in the browser settings, or type the code.
scan.noCamera: No camera found. Type the code instead.
find.noStock: None in stock in this warehouse.
find.nothing: No product or bin has the code {code}.
customers.title: Customers
customers.hint: Who you ship to. Sales orders use this list.
import.hint.customers: Rows with a new code are added; existing codes are updated.
import.hint.sales-orders: One row per order line. Rows with the same order_ref become one draft order. An order_ref already imported for that customer is refused.
so.title: Sales orders
so.hint: What customers have ordered. Drafts can still be changed; picking comes once an order is released.
so.search: Search number, customer or their order no.
so.shipToHint: The customer’s address, unless you type another
error.CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND: That customer no longer exists or was archived.
error.SO_NOT_DRAFT: This order is no longer a draft. Reload it to see its status.
error.SO_CHANGED: Someone else changed this order. Reload it and try again.
error.SO_CANNOT_CANCEL: Only a draft order can be cancelled.
error.ORDER_REF_EXISTS: This customer already has an order with that order number.
so.short: Not enough stock in bins to release this order. Short: {list}. Put away goods still in receiving, or change the order.
so.cancelReleasedHint: The reserved stock becomes free again and the order stays in the list as cancelled. This cannot be undone.
error.STALE: Someone else changed this just now. Reload and try again.
pick.title: Pick
pick.hint: Your pick lists and lists given to nobody, urgent first. Open one and follow it bin by bin.
pick.unitHint: Count in the unit you scanned: a case barcode counts cases.
pick.shortHint: {qty} {uom} still expected here. Say how many you found; the rest is marked short and the manager is told.
pick.allDone: Everything on this list is done. Take it to the dispatch area.
error.WRONG_BIN: That is not the bin on this line. Check the label.
error.WRONG_PRODUCT: That is not the product on this line.
error.OVER_PICK: That is more than is left on this line.
error.PICK_LINE_DONE: This line is already done. Reload the list.
error.PICK_LINE_NOT_FOUND: That line is not on this pick list.
pack.title: Pack
pack.hint: Picked orders waiting at the packing table, oldest first. Scan everything into the boxes.
pack.scan: Scan each product as it goes in the box
pack.notOnOrder: {code} is not on this order. Put it aside.
pack.tooMany: That is more {sku} than was picked ({picked} {uom}). Check the boxes.
pack.finishHint: Everything matches what was picked. How many cartons go out?
pack.done: Packed. Print both papers and put them with the boxes.
error.PACK_MISMATCH: What was scanned does not match what was picked. Count again.
error.SO_NOT_PICKED: Only a picked order can be packed.
error.SO_NOT_PACKED: This order is not packed yet, so it has no papers.
dispatch.title: Dispatch
dispatch.hint: Packed orders waiting for a vehicle. Tick the ones going on this trip and send them.
dispatch.confirmHint: The goods leave the dispatch area and the orders become shipped. This cannot be undone.
dispatch.sent: Shipment {number} has left. Orders on it: {n}.
board.title: Task board
board.hint: What waits at every stage, and who picks what.
error.USER_NOT_PICKER: That person cannot pick in this warehouse.
error.NOT_YOUR_LIST: This pick list is given to someone else.
dash.title: Dashboard
dash.hint: Stock, today's flow and how fast the floor works. Updates every minute.
dash.noCost: {n} products have no cost and are not counted
dash.binsNote: {used} of {all} bins; those in use are {fill}% full on average
dash.dockNote: Average wait in receiving before putaway, last 7 days
dash.linesNote: Average over days with picking, last 7 days
dash.noLowStock: Nothing is at or below its reorder point.
products.reorderRule: A number like 20, up to 3 decimals
error.EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: That is too many rows for one file. Narrow the dates, or use Excel instead of PDF.
